topic: How to encourage without nagging: the deal that works
caption:
Nagging never works. A deal does.

Tell your teen: earn $50 this month and you'll match it. Then step back and let them figure out how.

Most parents are shocked how fast a real incentive replaces the scrolling.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
